reason: A is the stronger proposal because it links a directly observed feature—cold-rolling-induced dislocation networks—to measurable work hardening and recovery, and tests that mediator through controlled mechanical tests plus in situ strain/dislocation measurements. B relies on the physically weak premise that constituent elements within a solid solution contract independently, conflates thermal mismatch with microsegregation, and predicts lower creep after removing internal stresses without adequate mechanistic support.
